title: Reader Chapter 30
hook: A reader-facing chapter under phase-1 review.

examples.title: Pascal kneels beside the black tire marks
examples.scenario: Pascal touches black tire arcs at Friday 5:54 p.m. in behind the wedding rental van in Lot C, event coordinator, with a crushed centerpiece box. The florist blamed the driver. The driver blamed the loading crew. After everyone leaves, Pascal sees the narrow lane, the late change to the pickup door, and his own missing traffic cone. Pascal he writes a contribution list before calling anyone careless.
examples.whyItMatters: It shows the skill in context.

examples.title: Gita turns the calendar toward the window
examples.scenario: Gita turns a glowing shared calendar at Monday 9:24 p.m. in the dark dining table in her rowhouse, co-parent, with two cold mugs of tea. Her ex moved the dental appointment without telling her. Gita's first line is you keep doing this. The calendar shows a narrower start: we both touched the schedule and one of us was surprised. Gita she must decide whether to open with accusation or a story they can both recognize.
examples.whyItMatters: It shows the skill in context.
